context: Naoko and Sho-young watch a soccer match on TV with snacks.
purpose: Aunt and nephew sharing sports excitement together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばちゃん、サッカー始まった!
lines.style: Urgent, bright leap upward. Rapid-fire announcement, no filter. Lean-in energy, as if Auntie might miss this moment. The specific thrill of a child who just discovered something happening right now.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うわ、ゴール!すごいやん!
lines.style: Sharp intake on the opening. Booming, generous voice—Kansai warmth turned up loud. Hand-slap energy. Matching Sho's excitement with the unselfconscious joy of an adult who plays to win.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Climbing pitch on 'might'—genuine hope cresting into belief. Quick, breathy between thoughts. Small body leaning forward. The precarious optimism of a child who knows the next moment could go either way.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Come on—let's cheer for this side!
lines.style: Declarative, inviting. Kansai lilt on the edges. Voice opens up—she's pulling Sho into a team. Warm authority without distance. The kind of aunt who makes a child feel chosen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Slightly breathless. Whole-body energy compressed into voice. Peak excitement without exhaustion—pure present-moment alive. Short, sharp clarity, then a small afterthought lingering.
